title: How Much Information Should Interest Rate-Setting Central Banks Reveal?
title_zh: 利率设定的中央银行应披露多少信息？
authors: Charles Wyplosz, Aileen Gosselin-Lotz, Pierre Gosselin, Charles Wyplosz; Aileen Gosselin-Lotz; Pierre Gosselin
official: 官方在线 2006-05-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Morris and Shin (2002) have shown that a central bank may be too transparent if the private sector pays too much attention to its possible imprecise signals simply because they are common knowledge. In their model, the central bank faces a binary choice: to reveal or not to reveal its information. This paper extends their model to the more realistic case where the central bank must anyway convey some information by setting the interest rate. This situation radically changes the conclusions. In many cases, full transparency is socially optimal. In other instances the central bank can distill information to either manipulate private sector expectations in a way that reduces the common knowledge effect or to reduce the unavoidable information content of the interest rate. In no circumstance is the option of only setting the interest rate socially optimal.
abstract_zh: Morris与Shin（2002）的研究表明，当私人部门过度关注央行可能不精确的信号（仅因其具有共同知识属性）时，央行透明度可能过高。在其模型中，央行面临二元选择：披露或不披露信息。本文将该模型拓展至更现实的场景——央行必须通过设定利率来传递信息。这一情境从根本上改变了原有结论。在许多情况下，完全透明是社会最优选择；在其他情形下，央行可通过信息提炼来操纵私人部门预期（以降低共同知识效应），或减少利率不可避免的信息含量。在任何情况下，仅设定利率的选项均非社会最优。

title: Extreme return connectedness among gambling tokens, gambling ETFs, and other assets: the role of global uncertainties and portfolio implications
title_zh: 赌博代币、赌博ETF及其他资产的极端收益关联性：全球不确定性的作用与投资组合影响
authors: Chin Man Chui, Han Yang, Peixiu Chen, Ifran Khan, Cody Yu-Ling Hsiao
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study investigates return spillovers among gambling tokens, gambling exchange-traded funds (ETFs), and traditional financial assets using a Quantile Vector Autoregression (QVAR) framework, while evaluating portfolio diversification strategies and the role of global uncertainties. Empirical results demonstrate that connectedness across these markets intensifies significantly at extreme quantiles of the return distribution compared to median quantiles, indicating that gambling tokens function as effective diversifiers under normal market conditions. However, their diversification efficacy attenuates during periods of economic turmoil. Notably, gambling tokens exhibit robust tail risk mitigation during market downturns and recovery phases. Dynamic portfolios incorporating these tokens outperform static buy-and-hold strategies in risk management. Furthermore, Wavelet Quantile Regression (WQR) analysis reveals heterogeneous impacts of global uncertainties on return connectedness, with effects contingent on market conditions and time horizons. Specifically, uncertainty-driven spillovers are most pronounced during bearish regimes and at longer time scales. These findings underscore the importance of adaptive portfolio strategies and provide critical insights for investors seeking to balance diversification benefits with tail-risk resilience in an increasingly interconnected global financial market.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用分位数向量自回归（QVAR）框架，考察博彩代币、博彩交易所交易基金（ETF）与传统金融资产之间的收益溢出效应，同时评估投资组合多元化策略及全球不确定性的作用。实证结果表明，相较于中位数分位数，这些市场在收益分布的极端分位数处关联性显著增强，表明博彩代币在正常市场条件下可作为有效的多元化工具。然而，在经济动荡时期，其多元化效能有所减弱。值得注意的是，博彩代币在市场下行及复苏阶段展现出稳健的尾部风险缓释能力。纳入这些代币的动态投资组合在风险管理方面优于静态买入持有策略。此外，小波分位数回归（WQR）分析揭示了全球不确定性对收益关联性的异质性影响，其效应取决于市场状况与时间跨度。具体而言，不确定性驱动的溢出效应在熊市阶段及较长周期内最为显著。这些发现凸显了适应性投资组合策略的重要性，并为投资者在日益互联的全球金融市场中平衡多元化收益与尾部风险韧性提供了关键启示。

title: When Medicaid Pays the Bill: Routine Vision Benefits, Eye Care Use, and Eyeglasses Spending Among Dual-eligible Medicare Enrollees
title_zh: 当医疗补助支付账单：双重资格医疗保险参保者的常规视力福利、眼科护理使用与眼镜支出
authors: Michel H. Boudreaux, Brandy Lipton, Melissa McInerney
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Vision problems are prevalent among Medicare beneficiaries, with the majority having treatable conditions including uncorrected refractive error and cataracts. However, traditional Medicare does not cover routine eye exams or eyeglasses, and Medicare Advantage supplemental vision benefits often include low annual limits. We examine the effects of Medicaid routine vision benefits among adults dually eligible for Medicare and Medicaid, a population with high rates of vision impairment, morbidity, and disability. Using 2002-2019 Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey data and a difference-in-differences design, we estimate that Medicaid routine vision benefits increase past-year eye exams, eyeglasses purchases, and Medicaid spending on eyeglasses while reducing out-of-pocket spending. We also find suggestive evidence of spillovers to Medicare Advantage spending on eyeglasses, consistent with Medicaid routine vision coverage inducing additional eyeglasses purchases among Medicare Advantage enrollees with supplemental vision benefits, although estimates are modest.
abstract_zh: 视力问题在医疗保险受益人中普遍存在，其中多数人患有可治疗的眼部疾病，包括未矫正屈光不正和白内障。然而，传统医疗保险不覆盖常规眼科检查或眼镜费用，而医疗保险优势计划的补充视力福利通常包含较低的年度限额。本研究考察了医疗补助常规视力福利对同时符合医疗保险和医疗补助资格的成年人的影响——该群体视力损伤、患病率和残疾率均较高。基于2002-2019年医疗保险当前受益人调查数据，采用双重差分法，我们估算出医疗补助常规视力福利使过去一年眼科检查率、眼镜购买量及医疗补助眼镜支出增加，同时减少了自付费用。我们还发现存在向医疗保险优势计划眼镜支出的溢出效应证据，这与医疗补助常规视力覆盖促使已享有补充视力福利的医疗保险优势计划参保人额外购买眼镜的现象一致，尽管估算结果较为温和。

title: International transmission of inflation in the commodity market during crises: evidence based on a multi-layer local Gaussian correlation network
title_zh: 危机期间商品市场通胀的国际传导：基于多层局部高斯相关网络的证据
authors: Yixiong Xu, Feipeng Zhang, Di Yuan, Yun Hong, Xu Liu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study develops a multi-layer local Gaussian correlation network approach to examine crisis-specific commodity – inflation linkages across the G7 and E7 economies. The empirical results show that mean inflation correlations between the E7 and G7 are lower than within-group correlations, suggesting differences in inflation co-movements between advanced and emerging economies. Energy – inflation linkages are generally stronger than both cross-country inflation linkages and agricultural commodity – inflation associations, with all correlations rising noticeably during major global crises. These patterns also display clear quantile heterogeneity. At the low inflation quantile, commodity – inflation linkages are relatively broad-based across the G7 and E7 economies, whereas they become denser and more concentrated at higher inflation quantiles. Major crises also reshape the network structure in distinct ways. The 2008 crisis is marked by the central role of agricultural commodities, the COVID-19 pandemic by a more balanced energy – agriculture pattern, and the 2022 Russia – Ukraine war by the prominence of the Russia – natural gas linkage. Overall, the results suggest that commodity – inflation linkages are shaped jointly by inflation regimes, commodity characteristics, and crisis-specific structural shocks. The findings also provide useful implications for policymakers in designing tailored response strategies that take account of quantile-dependent risks and event-driven vulnerabilities in global commodity markets.
abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一种多层局部高斯相关网络方法，以考察G7与E7经济体中危机特定的大宗商品与通胀之间的关联。实证结果表明，E7与G7之间的平均通胀相关性低于组内相关性，这表明发达经济体与新兴经济体在通胀联动方面存在差异。能源与通胀的关联普遍强于跨国通胀关联以及农产品与通胀的关联，且所有相关性在全球重大危机期间均显著上升。这些模式还呈现出明显的分位数异质性。在低通胀分位数下，大宗商品与通胀的关联在G7与E7经济体中相对广泛，而在高通胀分位数下，这些关联变得更加密集和集中。重大危机也以不同方式重塑了网络结构。2008年危机以农产品为核心角色为特征，新冠疫情则表现为更为平衡的能源-农产品模式，而2022年俄乌战争则凸显了俄罗斯-天然气关联的重要性。总体而言，结果表明大宗商品与通胀的关联由通胀机制、大宗商品特性以及危机特定的结构性冲击共同塑造。这些发现也为政策制定者设计考虑分位数依赖风险与全球大宗商品市场事件驱动脆弱性的定制化应对策略提供了有益启示。

title: The Fragility of Perfectly Safe Digital Money
authors: Elizabeth C. Klee, Arazi Lubis, Chase P. Ross, Sharon Y. Ross, Alexandros P. Vardoulakis
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Digital money differs from previous forms of money in an important way: it unbundles trust. Instead of relying on a trustworthy institution to settle payments, it relies on decentralized verification, whose cost is priced separately through congestion-sensitive gas fees. This arrangement creates a novel fragility from the interaction of two opposing forces: network externalities, which make digital money more valuable as adoption rises, and congestion fees, which make it more costly to use. We show that these forces generate strategic complementarities in redemption decisions and can create runs even when digital money is backed by perfectly safe reserves.
abstract_zh: 数字货币与以往货币形式的一个关键区别在于：它将信任解绑。数字货币不再依赖可信机构进行支付结算，而是依靠去中心化验证，其成本通过拥堵敏感型的燃料费单独定价。这种机制因两种对立力量的相互作用而产生了一种新型脆弱性：网络外部性使数字货币随采用率上升而增值，而拥堵费则提高了使用成本。我们证明，这些力量会在赎回决策中产生战略互补性，即便数字货币由完全安全的储备资产支持，也可能引发挤兑。

title: Simple forward induction in monotonic multi-sender signaling games
title_zh: 单调多发送者信号博弈中的简单前向归纳
authors: Péter Vida, Takakazu Honryo, Helmuts Āzacis
abstract: We introduce a new, powerful, and easy-to-use solution concept called simple forward induction which is implied by strategic stability in generic finite multi-sender signaling games. We apply this concept to infinite monotonic signaling games and show that a unique simple forward induction outcome exists and is non-distorted by asymmetric information. We also show that, in this class of games, the non-distorted outcome is the limit of stable outcomes of finite games. Hence, in this sense, we characterize stable outcomes in this class of games. The definition of our solution concept can be easily extended to arbitrary extensive-form games.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖、强大且易于使用的解概念，称为简单前向归纳法，该概念在一般有限多发送者信号博弈中由策略稳定性所蕴含。我们将这一概念应用于无限单调信号博弈，并证明存在唯一的简单前向归纳结果，且该结果不受信息不对称的扭曲。我们还证明，在此类博弈中，非扭曲结果是有限博弈稳定结果的极限。因此，在此意义上，我们刻画了此类博弈中的稳定结果。我们的解概念定义可轻松推广至任意扩展式博弈。

title: Intergenerational Mobility in the Land of Inequality
title_zh: 不平等之地中的代际流动性
authors: Diogo G. C. Britto, Alexandre Fonseca, Paolo Pinotti, Breno Sampaio, Lucas Warwar
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We provide the first estimates of intergenerational income mobility using tax data for a large developing country, namely Brazil. We measure formal income from tax and payroll data, and we train machine learning models on census and survey data to predict informal income. We quantify the estimation bias resulting from income imputation and other sources of measurement error, and show that such bias remains negligible in our context. A 10 percentile increase in parental income rank is associated on average with a 5.5 percentile increase in child income rank, with considerable variation across sociodemographic groups and geographical areas.
abstract_zh: 我们利用巴西这一大型发展中国家的税收数据，首次估算了代际收入流动性。通过税收和工资数据衡量正规收入，并基于人口普查和调查数据训练机器学习模型以预测非正规收入。我们量化了因收入估算及其他测量误差导致的估计偏差，并证明此类偏差在我们的研究中可忽略不计。父母收入排名每提高10个百分位，子女收入排名平均上升5.5个百分位，且不同社会人口群体和地理区域之间存在显著差异。

title: Inference for Regression with Variables Generated by AI or Machine Learning
title_zh: 基于AI或机器学习生成变量的回归推断
authors: Laura Battaglia, Tim Christensen, Stephen Hansen, Szymon Sacher
official: 官方在线 2024-05-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: It has become common practice for researchers to use AI-powered information retrieval algorithms or other machine learning methods to estimate variables of economic interest, then use these estimates as covariates in a regression model. We show both theoretically and empirically that naively treating AI- and ML-generated variables as “data” leads to biased estimates and invalid inference. We propose two methods to correct bias and perform valid inference: (i) an explicit bias correction with bias-corrected confidence intervals, and (ii) joint maximum likelihood estimation of the regression model and the variables of interest. Through several applications, we demonstrate that the common approach generates substantial bias, while both corrections perform well.
abstract_zh: 研究者普遍采用人工智能驱动的信息检索算法或其他机器学习方法估算经济变量，随后将这些估算值作为回归模型中的协变量。我们通过理论与实证分析表明，若将人工智能与机器学习生成的变量简单视为"数据"，将导致有偏估计与无效推断。为此提出两种修正偏差并实现有效推断的方法：（i）采用显式偏差校正法构建偏差校正置信区间；（ii）对回归模型与目标变量进行联合极大似然估计。通过多项应用验证，常规方法会产生显著偏差，而两种修正方法均表现良好。
